surfaces.adaptive_pattern: Small libadwaita appearance panel opened from the header-bar Appearance button with app appearance controls, visual editor palette tiles, and current-line highlight.
surfaces.collapse_behavior: The compact controls remain vertically stacked, and the palette grid keeps stable visual choices without hiding palettes dynamically.

surfaces.adaptive_pattern: Single-page libadwaita preferences dialog with standard rows for word wrap, line numbers, optional minimap, monospace editor font, staged indentation controls, autosave, and document format controls.
surfaces.collapse_behavior: Rows stay vertically stacked, SpinRows keep their numeric editor inline without horizontal scrolling, and the dialog remains usable at narrow widths without secondary pages.

surfaces.adaptive_pattern: Standard shortcuts window grouped into file, tab, search, view, project, and app actions (including Open Folder and Refresh Project Tree).
surfaces.collapse_behavior: Shortcut groups continue stacking in reading order as width tightens.

surfaces.adaptive_pattern: Single-window editor shell with a header bar, an overlay project sidebar for folder navigation, a runtime-inserted search bar above the tabs, per-tab banners for ongoing file state, optional minimaps inside tab content, a tabbed workspace, and a bottom status bar whose format menu also exposes zoom actions.
surfaces.collapse_behavior: Header actions stay reachable while the project sidebar can be shown or hidden without displacing the editor, the search rows stack above the tabs, per-tab banners stay above editor content, the minimap remains a narrow fixed strip when enabled without taking over the layout, and the single status-bar format surface keeps format and zoom actions reachable at narrow widths.

surfaces.adaptive_pattern: Centered window title reflects the selected tab title and subtitle while search, banners, and status chrome are added outside the title area.
surfaces.collapse_behavior: The title truncates naturally before it displaces primary header-bar actions.
